review.procedure: Per repository, the after rules ran as `urgent-first github` would (repository templates, labels stripped), then `urgent-first annotate-template` wrote the default review queue (every item below T1, plus items with negated, historical or spelling-tolerant mentions). One fresh Claude subagent per split read only the queue files, the pack review.md and the annotation contract, with no gold labels, no ids or results files and no network, and wrote annotations.jsonl. `urgent-first merge` validated them. Nothing was tuned on the results.
